---
title: "Lesson 2: Linear Maps"
---

## Overview

Linear maps preserve the structure of vector spaces.

## Intuition

A linear map sends straight lines to straight lines and preserves the origin.

## Formal Definition

A map $T: V \to W$ is linear if

$$
T(u+v)=T(u)+T(v), \qquad T(\lambda u)=\lambda T(u).
$$

## Examples

- Rotation in the plane
- Projection onto an axis
- Differentiation on polynomial spaces
